proof_body:
by
  intro α _ _
  rw [card_derangements_eq_numDerangements]
  generalize Fintype.card α = n
  have h := numDerangements_sum n
  have h' : (numDerangements n : ℚ) = ((numDerangements n : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    push_cast
    rfl
  rw [h', h]
  push_cast
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  have hk' : k ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
  have hf := Nat.factorial_mul_ascFactorial k (n - k)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hk'] at hf
  have hne : (k.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero k
  congr 1
  rw [eq_div_iff hne]
  have hf' : (k + 1).ascFactorial (n - k) * k.factorial = n.factorial := by
    rw [Nat.mul_comm]
    exact hf
  exact_mod_cast hf'
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α], (Fintype.card (derangements α) : ℚ) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card α + 1), (-1 : ℚ) ^ k * (((Fintype.card α).factorial : ℚ) / (k.factorial : ℚ))
